[[File:RogueSquadron_cover_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The New Republic task force during the [[First Battle of Borleias]].]]
In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] '''task force''' was assembled to [[First Battle of Borleias|capture]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] held [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]]. It consisted of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Emancipator]]'', the [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruisers]] [[Corulag (bulk cruiser)|''Corulag'']] and ''[[Mon Valle]]'', and the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Eridain]]''. [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] support consisted of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Defender Wing]], as well as eight [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttles]] including ''[[Modaran]]'' and ''[[Devonian]]''.
